Package dev.salusa.crypto

Class SequenceFunctionSpec

java.lang.Object
dev.salusa.crypto.SequenceFunctionSpec
All Implemented Interfaces:
AlgorithmParameterSpec
public class SequenceFunctionSpec extends Object implements AlgorithmParameterSpec
Immutable specification for an instance of SequenceFunction. Comes with prebuilt instances for the most common cases.

  • Method Details

    • jce

      public static SequenceFunctionSpec jce(String hashName, int blockSize)
      Creates an instance of SequenceFunctionSpec where the MessageDigest is produced by calling MessageDigest.getInstance(String) with hashName.
      Parameters:
      hashName - value to pass to MessageDigest.getInstance(String)
      blockSize - the underlying block-size of the hash function. This is not the output size of the hash function.

    • jce

      public static SequenceFunctionSpec jce(String hashName, String providerName, int blockSize)
      Creates an instance of SequenceFunctionSpec where the MessageDigest is produced by calling MessageDigest.getInstance(String, String) with hashName and providerName.
      Parameters:
      hashName - value to pass to MessageDigest.getInstance(String, String)
      providerName - value to pass to MessageDigest.getInstance(String, String)
      blockSize - the underlying block-size of the hash function. This is not the output size of the hash function.

    • jce

      public static SequenceFunctionSpec jce(String hashName, Provider provider, int blockSize)
      Creates an instance of SequenceFunctionSpec where the MessageDigest is produced by calling MessageDigest.getInstance(String, Provider) with hashName and provider.
      Parameters:
      hashName - value to pass to MessageDigest.getInstance(String, Provider)
      provider - value to pass to MessageDigest.getInstance(String, Provider)
      blockSize - the underlying block-size of the hash function. This is not the output size of the hash function.

    • cloned

      public static SequenceFunctionSpec cloned(String hashName, int blockSize, MessageDigest hash)
      Creates an instance of SequenceFunctionSpec where the MessageDigest returned by getHash() is simply hash.clone().

      hash MUST be in a freshly initialized state.

      Parameters:
      hashName - value to pass to MessageDigest.getInstance(String, Provider)
      hash - value return from getHash()
      blockSize - the underlying block-size of the hash function. This is not the output size of the hash function.

    • supplier

      public static SequenceFunctionSpec supplier(String hashName, int blockSize, ThrowingSupplier<MessageDigest,GeneralSecurityException> supplier)
      Creates an instance of SequenceFunctionSpec where getHash() delegates directly to calling supplier.

      supplier MUST return a new instance for every calls

      Parameters:
      hashName - value to pass to MessageDigest.getInstance(String, Provider)
      supplier - supplier for getHash()
      blockSize - the underlying block-size of the hash function. This is not the output size of the hash function.
